decision_conditions: The application fails to demonstrate, on the balance of probability, that the proposed mobile home/caravan at the rear of  38 Turkey Street would satisfy the statutory definition of a caravan under Section 13(1) of the Caravan Sites Act 1968 (as amended). The structure would be assembled on site from multiple components in a manner akin to building operations rather than the joining of two pre-formed sections, and no evidence has been provided to show that it could be moved intact. The assembly works, including installation of ground screws and connection to services, would constitute operational development for the purposes of Section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended). Furthermore, the scale and facilities of the unit mean it could function independently, and there is insufficient certainty that its use would remain ancillary to the main dwelling. On this basis, a Certificate of Lawfulness cannot be issued.
description: Use of land at rear to station a mobile home as granny annexe.
